# Prism 1.30.0

Unmodified upstream core, Bash and Python grammars, bundled for offline highlighting.
Loaded in manual mode; no autoloader, CDN or runtime network request is used.

- Source: https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/tree/v1.30.0/components
- Files: `prism-core.min.js`, `prism-bash.min.js`, `prism-python.min.js`
- License: MIT; full notice in `runtime/licenses/prism/LICENSE`.

When updating, replace all files from the same pinned upstream version,
update the notice, and run the editor and localization checks.
